title: Renewal of a Turkish identity card (T.C. Kimlik Kartı): expired, lost or damaged
scope: Turkish citizens in Türkiye who already hold a chip identity card (T.C. Kimlik Kartı) and need a new one because it expired, was lost or stolen, or is damaged.
excluded: a first card or replacing a paper nüfus cüzdanı (see tc_kimlik_first)
changed registered information such as a new surname (not modelled yet)
people under legal restriction and children under state protection
